# Handoff Analysis

## Summary

| Metric | Champion v5 | Last PASS Candidate | Delta |
|--------|-------------|---------------------|-------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 | -7.5% |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 | ⚠️ -88% |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** | ~same |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** | +18.8% |
| Worst MDD | **-9.3%** | -11.2% | worse |

## Status

```
✓ Champion v5 remains stable
✓ No INCONCLUSIVE candidates blocking
⏱ ~3h remaining in runloop (418 iterations done)
```

## Key Observations

1. **Champion holding** — The `exp_macro_alpha_shadow` candidate passed but couldn't dethrone champion due to:
   - Much worse tuning_min (0.05 vs 0.43) → fragile in some folds
   - Higher drawdown risk (-11.2% vs -9.3%)

2. **Candidate strengths** — Better lockbox_min suggests more robust out-of-sample floor, worth noting for future exploration

3. **Final stretch** — With only 3h left, focus on letting the autopilot complete and collecting the final reports

## Recommended Execution

```bash
# 1. Continue AUB search (select-best mode)
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best

# 2. Run system candidates
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run

# 3. Generate next-fix report for post-loop review
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Post-Loop Priority

When loop completes, review `next_fix.md` for:
- Fold14 MDD sensitivity (both configs hit ~9-10% there)
- Tuning_min variance investigation
- Whether lockbox_min improvement direction is worth pursuing
